blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS— The Minnesota Timberwolves were forced to put their grand plan of pairing Anthony Edwards in the backcourt with LaMelo Ball on temporary hold when the knee injury nagging Edwards got to the point where surgery was recommended. Putting Ayo Dosunmu in the starting lineup in place of Edwards has produced a duo with Ball that’s plenty dynamic in its own right, one reason why the Timberwolves have not fallen off track while their superstar guard is in recovery. “They both can really score at all different levels,” coach Chris Finch said. “Those two guys open up a lot of things […]...
